findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
The wasn’t any hand soap in the women’s restroom at the start of the inspection. Discussed with PIC and hand soap was provided. Ensure that hand soap is always available at a hand sink in order to properly wash hands.   

6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
In the storage closet to the left of the bar, the floor appears to be caving in badly. The ice machine is also stored inside of the closet. PIC noted that the floor can’t be repaired until the ice machine is removed from the room. PIC also noted that the ice machine is rented. There is a note placed on the ice machine that states that the company who owns the machine will be to pick it up April 8, 2024. Overall, the facility is aware that the floor is in need of repair and is currently working to get this issue resolved.

A referral has been made to Sangamon County Building and Zoning. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
Employee reporting agreement were not available during the inspection. Employees had not signed agreements. All employees must sign employee health reporting agreements, and they must available for review during inspections. 

2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
The ice machine was observed soiled with mold and mildew. Ensure the ice machine is cleaned at a frequency that is is maintained clean to avoid contamination of ice from mold. 

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Observed the area on the bottom of the soda nozzle holder to be soiled. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation. The PIC stated the holder would be cleaned later tonight.  Reference 4-602.13.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment: 410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.  Reference 410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430.
